meta.title: Recreate a serial bidding event with Evaluation cleared

plan.title: Recreate Serial Bidding Order Without Evaluation

steps.note: Open the existing prepared closed RFQ event on its summary page.
Open the stage Settings menu and choose Recreate Order.

args.goal: clear Evaluation Duration, click Create Order, and stop when the serial-bidding evaluation-time refusal is shown

steps.note: Perform the buyer-side form actions that have no dedicated catalog step.

args.text: Evaluation time is mandatory for serial bidding

steps.note: Assert the expected refusal message after attempting to create the order.
